rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Bind each waiting frame to its own snapshot/node address
rows.proves: Two live frames get distinct snapshot nodes, frame nodes and digests; both resolve RESOLVED_LIVE_FRAME in a view rendered while suspended; the authorized RETURN_PRIMITIVE then RETURN_COMPOUND intents name exactly those frame ids in dependency order; root x=3 COMPLETE; in the final view both resolve RESOLVED_HISTORICAL_FRAME_NOT_LIVE.
rows.boundary: The native exact return itself is upstream behavior (test_compound_kernel.py::test_real_nested_construction_installs_program_and_resumes_exact_parent at the runtime commit; not in the 61-case suite). This case binds that behavior to addresses; it does not re-prove the kernel.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Wrong atlas address cannot choose another native continuation
rows.proves: A crossed address (outer suspension with the inner continuation) is refused SUSPENSION_EVENT_FRAME_MISMATCH; a foreign run id is refused SUSPENSION_EVENT_MISMATCH; the module exposes no resume/dispatch/commit/advance name; journal and stack unchanged.
rows.boundary: Refusal at the address layer only. Native wrong-frame refusal is upstream (test_wrong_return_frame_cannot_resume_or_write_parent).

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Repeated view event cannot dispatch a new native request
rows.proves: Five resolutions and five chain computations leave state hash, trace length, native budget and the journal byte-identical.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Preserve root/parent address chain across restart
rows.proves: The suspended journal is recovered in a separate Python process (subprocess) with the caller-held journal digest; the recomputed chain, including both address digests and the root call occurrence, equals the original.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Do not reconstruct budget from suspended snapshot
rows.proves: The address has no budget or remaining field; after the nested work completes the live ledger is strictly below the frame's entry budget; the entry budget stays in the continuation as history only.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Equal/missing profiles cannot merge two call occurrences
rows.proves: Two occurrences with the same source profile and root goal but different inputs get different run ids, snapshot nodes, frame nodes and digests; one's address is refused in the other's view; a live frame of one machine is FRAME_NOT_LIVE on the other; supplied profile coordinates are refused PROFILE_COORDINATES_HAVE_NO_ADDRESS_ROLE.
rows.boundary: Recorded fact: a machine started from byte-identical inputs is deterministic and reaches the identical run id and frame identities; that is the same episode identity, not a merge of two callers.

rows.proves: AtlasSnapshot.focus to another node and the flat_graph presentation give the same resolution (only the reported focus differs); the journal is unchanged.
rows.boundary: The pinned atlas has no geometric layout; focus and flat/graph presentation are the existing view operations.

rows.proves: Two computations of the same frame's address are identical; swapping the suspension event hash for another event's hash is refused SUSPENSION_EVENT_MISMATCH; the unique authorized push event is the one bound.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: No successful adapter view from tampered replay
rows.proves: A view whose snapshot node state_hash is altered is refused SNAPSHOT_NODE_MISMATCH; a view missing the waiting node is refused WAITING_NODE_NOT_FOUND; a truncated journal fails native recovery (ContractError) before any address exists; an altered address fails its digest.

rows.new_adapter_case_needed: Use exact matching frame/snapshot, no nearest-node fallback
rows.proves: An address whose snapshot hash differs in one hex digit is refused although the real node is present in the view; after the exact return the frame is FRAME_NOT_LIVE.
